HVG: 2000 sample-aware genes independently per age; mitochondrial/ribosomal and listed sex markers excluded
Harmony: Within each age, sample key, theta2 lambda1 nclust30 max20iterations; no cross-age alignment
sensitivity: Regress within-age QC/sex-marker covariates from Harmony PCs; can remove biological state and is not treated as proof of absence
markers: Original corrected-count log1p/10000; cluster vs same-age rest, each library checked independently; no inferential tests
limitations: Two library labels are not assumed to be independent animals. Higher resolution is not proof of new types. Anatomical program names remain candidates. Metadata-only H5ADs contain no expression. Count matrices unchanged.
program_label_rule: At least 2 panel genes with mean log difference >0.1 versus same-stage rest, corrected detection >=10%, and positive >0.05 expression contrasts in both libraries; positive aggregate panel score required. Compact requires both Hey2/Mycn; trabecular requires >=2 including Bmp10 or Erbb4. Cycling label additionally requires >=10% cycling-marker-positive nuclei. Labels describe partial relative programs, not pathway tests or functional identities.
